name: Water Lane
bedsNote: All three bedrooms are on the ground floor (single storey)
tagline: A 1930s town-centre bungalow needing modernisation on a private half-acre with five sheds, a short walk from Castlepollard's square in north Westmeath.

pros.detail: €3,404/m². Stamp duty about €3,200, leaving room to extend.
Bedroom Three (4.7 x 2.5 m double, rear, fitted wardrobes) is the obvious parents' room, next to the bathroom.
Castlepollard Mixed NS (160 pupils, DEIS) is on the same street, 160 m; the community college (DEIS, 318) is 1.1 km. St Finian's in Mullingar (~20 km) is the stronger secondary.
On a lane off Castlepollard's square: shops, Centra, pubs, GP all on foot.
0.2 ha of mature trees and lawn plus five powered block sheds; a big yard, short of the acre target.
Mullingar station (Sligo–Dublin line) about 25 minutes away, then about 1h15 to Connolly.
Lough Derravaragh and Tullynally Castle nearby; some summer letting appeal.

cons.detail: Well below the 140 m² floor; reaching ~150 m² is a rough €100–180k extension.
No central heating listed; a 1935 house needing full insulation and heating, a rough €50–80k before grants.
Listed as needing updating throughout; one bathroom.
0.5 acres is a good yard for two vizslas but under the 1-acre ideal.
Regional Hospital Mullingar is roughly 20 km; Cavan General is the alternative.
Town location suggests mains, but confirm.
